name: apresai-skills
description: Production-ready skills and plugins for Claude Code by apresai

plugins.name: apple-release
plugins.description: Apple app release automation for TestFlight and App Store Connect. Includes /release, /release-testflight, /release-consistency, /release-xcodecloud, and /app-store-audit (pre-submission risk audit against the full App Store Review Guidelines: project/binary AND App Store Connect metadata). Supports iOS, macOS, watchOS, visionOS.

plugins.name: go-lambda
plugins.description: Comprehensive Go Lambda development with provided.al2023 runtime, ARM64/Graviton2 architecture, AWS SDK v2, and CDK infrastructure. Covers scaffolding, migration, best practices, and production patterns.

plugins.name: nextjs-opennext
plugins.description: Deploy Next.js applications to AWS Lambda using OpenNext and CDK. Covers App Router, Server Components, ISR, streaming, middleware, and production deployment patterns.

plugins.name: bubbletea-design
plugins.description: Build beautiful, idiomatic terminal UIs in Go with Bubble Tea v2, Bubbles v2, and Lip Gloss v2. Architecture patterns, component catalog, styling recipes, async/streaming patterns, v1→v2 migration map, and visual design principles for sexy TUIs.

plugins.name: image-encoding
plugins.description: Modern web image encoding with AVIF (primary) and WebP (fallback). Covers cwebp/dwebp/avifenc CLIs, the <picture> cascade pattern, browser-support cliffs, and when each format wins.

plugins.name: chad-review
plugins.description: Adversarial pre-merge review for Claude Code. /ultra-audit is the merge gate (with chad-review 3.0.0+): it reviews the whole PR branch through a read-only staged lens, runs the project's gate and tests in your real worktree, deterministic doc, contract, and dependency scans, Opus finders that report everything, and Opus verifiers that refute a finding only with quoted proof (code, command output, the change's stated intent) or as a style preference no rule names, never on a confidence score; a red gate or failing test counts without a ruling. Fast depth (one finder) for small changes, deep depth (per-block finders, a challenger, one gap sweep) for risky, large, prompt, or status-bearing-doc changes; both keep every finding. Findings on the change are fixed in the PR at every severity, pre-existing ones go to one follow-up PR, a persisted ledger supplies the receipt counts, and a GO receipt must record zero open findings. /deps-update takes each dependency to its newest stable release within its current major as its own PR, keeping a manifest's update only on a green gate; ecosystems without an in-range updater are skipped and named. /chad-review remains the explicit 5-pass fan-out with session-relative sonnet/opus reviewers and the same verifier; its pass 5 updates dependencies in place. Not read-only: runs your gate, tests, codegen, and scanner; /ultra-audit applies /simplify and docs-apply edits to your branch and /chad-review rewrites manifests and lockfiles, all left uncommitted; both back up untracked files first.

plugins.name: codex-br
plugins.description: Run OpenAI Codex on Amazon Bedrock (model openai.gpt-5.6-sol, provider amazon-bedrock) instead of the ChatGPT backend, via a `br` Codex profile. Adds /codex-br task (delegate a coding/diagnosis/research task), /codex-br review (built-in reviewer), and /codex-br adversarial-review (steerable challenge review). Defaults to maximum reasoning effort (ultra).

plugins.name: xai-voice
plugins.description: Master reference for xAI's three voice APIs: Grok Text-to-Speech (POST /v1/tts), Speech-to-Text (/v1/stt), and the realtime Speech-to-Speech voice agent (wss://api.x.ai/v1/realtime). Live-verified request and response contracts, the full 26-voice catalog (docs still say 5), speech-tag semantics, a production Go client, and the doc-vs-reality discrepancies that ship broken audio.
